note: Changelog for finp2p.info. Newest first. kind: network (something changed on FinP2P itself) or site (something changed here). Every network entry carries a public source.

entries.title: Ownera's Tokenized Treasury Manager added
entries.body: Ownera's own collateral and intraday repo application (inventory and funding, collateral management, treasury hub) is now on the network page, with Transcend as a named optimization integration and Commerzbank's quote as a GDF sandbox participant.

entries.title: Five institutions from Ownera's partner logos
entries.body: ABN AMRO, Tokentus Investment AG, K3, TomNext and Future of Finance appear among the "Trusted By" logos on Ownera's home page. Listed as named associations; Ownera does not describe the relationships.

entries.title: Tezos adapter archived; open-code updates
entries.body: Ownera archived its Tezos adapter repository on 1 Nov. Also noted on the developer guide: EVM adapter v0.29.0, swap and move instructions and EIP-712 handling in the Node.js skeleton, and collateral-terms v3 in the certificates spec.

entries.title: Corrections
entries.body: Store production count in the FAQ now 15 (it left out the Router License listing); the Open Collateral Network pilots are described as slated for September 2026, as Ownera has not announced their start; Polygon re-sourced to Ownera's Tokenized Treasury Manager page, and Base dropped as Ownera's site no longer names it; the authentication note now reflects that Ownera's reference uses apiKey in its own sample.

entries.title: Utila partners with Ownera
entries.body: Ownera announced a partnership with Utila, pairing Utila's wallet infrastructure and transaction governance with the FinP2P network and SuperApps platform. Added to the custody layer on the network page.

entries.title: Store re-checked: no listing changes
entries.body: Re-pulled the SuperApps store API. Still 35 apps, 15 in production, with no new listings, removals or status changes since the 20 September snapshot.

entries.title: Developer guide, agent guide, FAQ and search
entries.body: New pages: a community field guide to building on FinP2P, a guide for AI agents and LLMs (including Ownera's docs MCP server), an FAQ, site search and this changelog with an RSS feed. Plain-text versions at /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt.

entries.title: finp2p.info launches
entries.body: An independent, sourced map of the FinP2P network: every SuperApp on the store, the institutions attached to each, how a transaction moves, and a public source for every claim.
